svg.title: Tests dominate measured Go-job execution
svg.desc: Test steps account for 88.4 percent; all other elapsed time accounts for 11.6 percent. Successful sampled Go jobs only.

g.text: Provisioning alone cannot remove most execution time
534 successful sampled Go jobs; summed elapsed time across parallel jobs.
Test steps include compilation and prerequisites. Other work includes setup, cleanup and gaps.
Even eliminating all other work would remove only 11.6% of this measured Go-job occupancy.
